units: <cite ref="Shabbat 29b:7">Sabb. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>גרר ס׳</he> dragged in a form (for the students to sit on). Y. ib. XV, beg. 15ᵃ <he>הן דמקפל על ס׳</he> he who folds a garment over a frame; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַפְסְלִין</he>, <he>סַפְסְלַיָּא</he>, <he>סַפְסְלַיָּיה</he>, <he>סַפְסְלֵי</he>.
